audience: Japanese IT professionals, especially SAP practitioners
productContext: Determine SAP ERP-facing, B2B SaaS admin, or mixed from the current task
notes: Use terminology.decisionsByKey for executable exact-pair meaning decisions (status provisional, ai-reviewed or confirmed); ai-reviewed requires reviewedBy and contextual evidence. termDecisions remains descriptive agent context.
provisionalRolesByKey records require exact English source, role, reason and status=provisional; they retain low confidence until actual user confirmation.
Copy only if a persistent application profile is useful.
An empty termDecisions list means no user-approved choices are asserted.
A decision for one application does not automatically apply to another.
Use JSON Pointer paths in unchangedKeys; record a specific reason in the delivery report.
The UI-writing width thresholds are adjustable project triage heuristics, not actual pixels or universal Japanese/SAP standards.
UI exceptions must bind exact source and target text, finding codes and a specific reason; a blanket style allowlist is not sufficient.

rolesByKey/rolesByPattern can declare action, label, heading, status, message, guidance, confirmation, empty-state, accessibility or technical; patterns are globs on the JSON Pointer, longest match first.
style: compact reproduces the legacy audit for older runs.
